title: Aether AI Analytics Engine
description: Real-time stream processing platform with AI-driven analytics, custom dashboard visualization, and micro-frontend architecture.
longDescription: A high-performance analytics platform built for enterprise metric tracking. Uses Next.js App Router with Server Sent Events for live telemetry data streams, coupled with custom canvas rendering for 60fps graph animations.

title: SAP S/4HANA Cloud Integration Gateway
description: Enterprise cloud connector seamlessly bridging SAP S/4HANA ERP backends with custom React frontend web applications.
longDescription: Developed custom OData v4 APIs, SAP BTP middleware service layer, and a high-availability queue processing engine handling 100,000+ daily financial transactions across global hubs.

title: Vortex Design System & Component Studio
description: Accessible, glassmorphic UI library with dark mode primitives, fluid typography, and dynamic motion presets.
longDescription: A unified component design system adopted by 12 internal feature teams. Built with Tailwind CSS v4, Radix primitives, and Framer Motion for zero-layout-shift UI interactions.

title: OmniCloud Kubernetes Monitor
description: Multi-cluster Kubernetes management portal with cluster topology mapping and automated anomaly detection.
longDescription: Monitors multi-cloud deployment clusters across AWS, GCP, and Azure. Provides interactive 3D topology visuals and automated incident resolution workflows.

title: Neuron Commerce OS
description: Sub-second headless e-commerce storefront with localized pricing, dynamic inventory sync, and AI product recommendations.
longDescription: Built for high-volume retail traffic with server-side rendering caching strategies, GraphQL API mesh, and stripe terminal payments integration.

title: SAP Fiori Smart Supply Chain App
description: Custom SAP Fiori/SAPUI5 application optimizing global supply chain logistics and real-time inventory tracking.
longDescription: Streamlined warehouse operations by 40% using SAP Fiori Elements, custom SAPUI5 controls, and offline-first PWA sync capabilities.
